{"result":{"id":"40d30834-77e0-4733-9548-ac53d75e1f04","assignees":[],"labels":[],"type_id":null,"created_at":null,"updated_at":null,"deleted_at":null,"point":null,"name":"Migration Charm v2 atomique en une PR (thème, touches, routeur, bubbles, ntcharts, profil couleur)","description_html":"

Story

En tant que mainteneur, je veux migrer DevDesk vers Bubble Tea v2, Bubbles v2, Lip Gloss v2 et ntcharts/v2 en une seule PR, en commits ordonnés, afin que l'arbre ne soit jamais mergé dans un état qui ne compile pas (la pile est couplée) et que la migration soit relue et vérifiée d'un bloc.

Critères d'acceptation

  • Given go.mod When la PR est prête Then il référence charm.land/bubbletea/v2 v2.1.1, charm.land/bubbles/v2 v2.2.1, charm.land/lipgloss/v2 v2.0.6, github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi v0.11.9 et github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2 v2.9.0, ne référence plus les anciens chemins github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea, bubbles, lipgloss, ntcharts v1 ni muesli/termenv ; go mod tidy et go mod verify sont propres (Rule 303).
  • Given la PR When elle est ouverte Then c'est une seule PR vers main (aucune branche d'intégration charm-v2, aucune PR par lot), avec des commits ordonnés : (a) theme (color.Color, lipgloss v2), (b) testutil et touches, (c) routeur et architecture des vues, (d) API bubbles (textinput, spinner, table, viewport) et désactivation de ←/→ dans les viewports, (e) ntcharts v2 et x/ansi, (f) profil couleur et suppression de termenv, (g) documentation (story DEVDESK-208). Les commits intermédiaires peuvent ne pas compiler seuls (pile couplée) ; la pointe compile et passe tout. La relecture se fait commit par commit ; le dépôt fusionne par squash, donc le message du commit final suit Rule 307.
  • Given l'architecture décidée (option C, choix de l'utilisateur) When le routeur est porté Then chaque vue de premier niveau garde Render() string et expose View() tea.View { return tea.NewView(m.Render()) } ; le routeur tient un map[ViewType]Screen, Screen étant tea.Model plus Render() string ; seul le routeur fixe l'état du terminal (AltScreen, couleurs, ReportFocus et autres champs de tea.View dans App.View) ; les composants (datatable, formulaires, FilterBar) gardent View() string ; la Rule 201 est conservée : les environ 480 signatures handle* renvoyant (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) ne changent pas.
  • Given les quatre ruptures silencieuses de la migration (espace, collage, ←/→ dans le viewport, largeurs) When la PR est préparée Then pour chacune un test existe qui échoue sur le code v2 non corrigé avant d'être corrigé (le commit ou la description de la PR en apporte la preuve) : (1) l'espace bascule une case à cocher et Entrée ne la bascule pas dans chaque formulaire ; (2) un collage atteint le champ focalisé (palette, formulaire, textinput, WrappedInput), y compris multiligne dans un champ d'une ligne, sans déclencher d'action ; (3) ←/→ ne font pas défiler un viewport ; (4) un datatable rendu à trois largeurs occupe exactement l'intérieur du viewport et mesure de la même façon les cellules à largeur ambiguë (icônes Nerd Font, emoji, ZWJ).
  • Given la touche espace When la migration est faite Then \"space\" est centralisé dans keymap.Space (DEVDESK-200) et aucune case ne compare plus \" \" ; les tests des cases à cocher (Rule 135) et le test source de DEVDESK-200 passent.
  • Given les touches When elles sont portées Then tea.KeyMsg devient tea.KeyPressMsg, testutil.Key construit les messages par Code/Text/Mod et laisse v2 calculer String() (aucune table imposant \" \") ; les ctrl+c, ctrl+r, ctrl+p, q, ?, / ont le même effet ; TestOnlyThreeCtrlCombinationsSurvive et TestNoBareLetterIsNavigation passent.
  • Given un collage When il atteint la palette ctrl+p, l'aide, un formulaire, un textinput ou un WrappedInput Then le routeur envoie tea.PasteMsg au champ focalisé et le test de collage de DEVDESK-199 passe tel quel.
  • Given le profil de couleur When le programme démarre Then il est géré par Bubble Tea (ColorProfileMsg, tea.WithColorProfile ; forcé en TrueColor si WT_SESSION, à confirmer par le spike), le contournement COLORTERM de main.go est retiré, lipgloss.SetColorProfile disparaît des 13 fichiers de test (helper de DEVDESK-199), et TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString garde sa cause « thème figé ».
  • Given le nouveau moteur de rendu et la sortie synchronisée (mode 2026) When TestMeasureRedrawCost tourne Then ses chiffres sont comparés à la référence de DEVDESK-200 (consignée dans docs/backlog.md) et ne sont pas pires, ou l'écart est expliqué par écrit.
  • Given theme et datatable When ils sont portés Then Rule 119 tient (hex seulement dans colors.go), un thème utilisateur existant donne les mêmes couleurs, contrast.go lit les composantes par RGBA(), et un datatable (colonne d'icônes, ligne sélectionnée, ligne en erreur, Spans, Cut/TailStyle) rendu à trois largeurs occupe exactement l'intérieur du viewport (Rule 116 : RenderedWidth), sans séquence ANSI coupée (Rule 122), fond uniforme (Rule 115), colonne d'icônes de 2 cellules (Rule 125). Les golden tests de overlay et de datatable passent avec x/ansi 0.11.9 ; si la mesure runewidth diverge de celle du moteur, l'écart est noté pour une story de suivi.
  • Given main.go et setup/wizard.go When ils sont portés Then tea.WithAltScreen() disparaît au profit du champ AltScreen de la vue, m.AttachProgram(p) et p.Send depuis le MCP fonctionnent comme avant (Rule 110), les options de test (WithInput, WithOutput, WithoutSignalHandler, WithoutRenderer) des 3 tests sont adaptées, et les 4 sites tea.ExecProcess (shell conteneur, -it OCI, pager V, terminal ws) rendent le terminal à DevDesk sans artefact.
  • Given ntcharts/v2 When le sparkline du dashboard (internal/ui/dashboard/chart.go) est porté Then chart_test.go passe et le rendu est identique à seuil et taille égaux.
  • Given DEVDESK-145 (en cours, modifie internal/ui/security) When la PR atomique atteint internal/ui/security (30 fichiers, :sec) Then elle est rebasée après le merge de DEVDESK-145 avant de toucher ce package ; l'ordre « scan starting » avant le scan (tea.Sequence de inventory_commands.go) est conservé.
  • Given les portes de qualité When la PR est livrée Then mise run check et mise run test-race sont verts, golangci-lint a 0 avertissement (Rule 301, 305), les tests de S1 (DEVDESK-199 et DEVDESK-200) sont verts, et la PR est relue avec la skill dev-team:large-diff-review.
  • Given la vérification manuelle (DEVDESK-207) When la PR est prête à merger Then elle a été faite au minimum sur Windows Terminal (dk.exe) et WSL, matrice minimale décidée par l'utilisateur : les 4 ExecProcess, l'espace dans chaque formulaire, le collage et les couleurs.

Contexte

Effort : L. Priorité : Must. Dépendances (bloquée par) : DEVDESK-197 (Go ≥ 1.26.8, S0), DEVDESK-199 et DEVDESK-200 (garde-fous sur v1, S1), DEVDESK-198 (spike). Les relations Plane (blocked_by) ne sont pas disponibles sur cette instance (404) : dépendances posées ici, dans le texte. Bloque : DEVDESK-207, DEVDESK-208, DEVDESK-209, DEVDESK-210, DEVDESK-211, DEVDESK-212 et les stories F5 et F6. Entrée : .claude/plans/charm-v2-impact.md (§1, §2, §4).

Décisions de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : migration ATOMIQUE en une seule PR, en remplacement des 6 lots sur une branche charm-v2 (stories DEVDESK-202 à 206 annulées, leur contenu est fusionné ici) ; architecture des vues : option C ; matrice de test minimale Windows Terminal + WSL ; pas d'usage SSH ni conteneur. Inclus : nouveau moteur de rendu et sync, profil couleur géré par Bubble Tea, routage de PasteMsg, \"space\" centralisé, viewport ←/→ désactivé, vigilance sur les largeurs. Ignorés : clavier Kitty / ctrl+shift, vrai curseur, souris, OSC 7501, nouveautés du viewport. Fonctionnalités reportées : stories de suivi du module.

Module : Migration Go 1.27 et Charm v2.

result.description_html:
Story

En tant que mainteneur, je veux migrer DevDesk vers Bubble Tea v2, Bubbles v2, Lip Gloss v2 et ntcharts/v2 en une seule PR, en commits ordonnés, afin que l'arbre ne soit jamais mergé dans un état qui ne compile pas (la pile est couplée) et que la migration soit relue et vérifiée d'un bloc.

Critères d'acceptation

  • Given go.mod When la PR est prête Then il référence charm.land/bubbletea/v2 v2.1.1, charm.land/bubbles/v2 v2.2.1, charm.land/lipgloss/v2 v2.0.6, github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi v0.11.9 et github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2 v2.9.0, ne référence plus les anciens chemins github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea, bubbles, lipgloss, ntcharts v1 ni muesli/termenv ; go mod tidy et go mod verify sont propres (Rule 303).
  • Given la PR When elle est ouverte Then c'est une seule PR vers main (aucune branche d'intégration charm-v2, aucune PR par lot), avec des commits ordonnés : (a) theme (color.Color, lipgloss v2), (b) testutil et touches, (c) routeur et architecture des vues, (d) API bubbles (textinput, spinner, table, viewport) et désactivation de ←/→ dans les viewports, (e) ntcharts v2 et x/ansi, (f) profil couleur et suppression de termenv, (g) documentation (story DEVDESK-208). Les commits intermédiaires peuvent ne pas compiler seuls (pile couplée) ; la pointe compile et passe tout. La relecture se fait commit par commit ; le dépôt fusionne par squash, donc le message du commit final suit Rule 307.
  • Given l'architecture décidée (option C, choix de l'utilisateur) When le routeur est porté Then chaque vue de premier niveau garde Render() string et expose View() tea.View { return tea.NewView(m.Render()) } ; le routeur tient un map[ViewType]Screen, Screen étant tea.Model plus Render() string ; seul le routeur fixe l'état du terminal (AltScreen, couleurs, ReportFocus et autres champs de tea.View dans App.View) ; les composants (datatable, formulaires, FilterBar) gardent View() string ; la Rule 201 est conservée : les environ 480 signatures handle* renvoyant (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) ne changent pas.
  • Given les quatre ruptures silencieuses de la migration (espace, collage, ←/→ dans le viewport, largeurs) When la PR est préparée Then pour chacune un test existe qui échoue sur le code v2 non corrigé avant d'être corrigé (le commit ou la description de la PR en apporte la preuve) : (1) l'espace bascule une case à cocher et Entrée ne la bascule pas dans chaque formulaire ; (2) un collage atteint le champ focalisé (palette, formulaire, textinput, WrappedInput), y compris multiligne dans un champ d'une ligne, sans déclencher d'action ; (3) ←/→ ne font pas défiler un viewport ; (4) un datatable rendu à trois largeurs occupe exactement l'intérieur du viewport et mesure de la même façon les cellules à largeur ambiguë (icônes Nerd Font, emoji, ZWJ).
  • Given la touche espace When la migration est faite Then "space" est centralisé dans keymap.Space (DEVDESK-200) et aucune case ne compare plus " " ; les tests des cases à cocher (Rule 135) et le test source de DEVDESK-200 passent.
  • Given les touches When elles sont portées Then tea.KeyMsg devient tea.KeyPressMsg, testutil.Key construit les messages par Code/Text/Mod et laisse v2 calculer String() (aucune table imposant " ") ; les ctrl+c, ctrl+r, ctrl+p, q, ?, / ont le même effet ; TestOnlyThreeCtrlCombinationsSurvive et TestNoBareLetterIsNavigation passent.
  • Given un collage When il atteint la palette ctrl+p, l'aide, un formulaire, un textinput ou un WrappedInput Then le routeur envoie tea.PasteMsg au champ focalisé et le test de collage de DEVDESK-199 passe tel quel.
  • Given le profil de couleur When le programme démarre Then il est géré par Bubble Tea (ColorProfileMsg, tea.WithColorProfile ; forcé en TrueColor si WT_SESSION, à confirmer par le spike), le contournement COLORTERM de main.go est retiré, lipgloss.SetColorProfile disparaît des 13 fichiers de test (helper de DEVDESK-199), et TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString garde sa cause « thème figé ».
  • Given le nouveau moteur de rendu et la sortie synchronisée (mode 2026) When TestMeasureRedrawCost tourne Then ses chiffres sont comparés à la référence de DEVDESK-200 (consignée dans docs/backlog.md) et ne sont pas pires, ou l'écart est expliqué par écrit.
  • Given theme et datatable When ils sont portés Then Rule 119 tient (hex seulement dans colors.go), un thème utilisateur existant donne les mêmes couleurs, contrast.go lit les composantes par RGBA(), et un datatable (colonne d'icônes, ligne sélectionnée, ligne en erreur, Spans, Cut/TailStyle) rendu à trois largeurs occupe exactement l'intérieur du viewport (Rule 116 : RenderedWidth), sans séquence ANSI coupée (Rule 122), fond uniforme (Rule 115), colonne d'icônes de 2 cellules (Rule 125). Les golden tests de overlay et de datatable passent avec x/ansi 0.11.9 ; si la mesure runewidth diverge de celle du moteur, l'écart est noté pour une story de suivi.
  • Given main.go et setup/wizard.go When ils sont portés Then tea.WithAltScreen() disparaît au profit du champ AltScreen de la vue, m.AttachProgram(p) et p.Send depuis le MCP fonctionnent comme avant (Rule 110), les options de test (WithInput, WithOutput, WithoutSignalHandler, WithoutRenderer) des 3 tests sont adaptées, et les 4 sites tea.ExecProcess (shell conteneur, -it OCI, pager V, terminal ws) rendent le terminal à DevDesk sans artefact.
  • Given ntcharts/v2 When le sparkline du dashboard (internal/ui/dashboard/chart.go) est porté Then chart_test.go passe et le rendu est identique à seuil et taille égaux.
  • Given DEVDESK-145 (en cours, modifie internal/ui/security) When la PR atomique atteint internal/ui/security (30 fichiers, :sec) Then elle est rebasée après le merge de DEVDESK-145 avant de toucher ce package ; l'ordre « scan starting » avant le scan (tea.Sequence de inventory_commands.go) est conservé.
  • Given les portes de qualité When la PR est livrée Then mise run check et mise run test-race sont verts, golangci-lint a 0 avertissement (Rule 301, 305), les tests de S1 (DEVDESK-199 et DEVDESK-200) sont verts, et la PR est relue avec la skill dev-team:large-diff-review.
  • Given la vérification manuelle (DEVDESK-207) When la PR est prête à merger Then elle a été faite au minimum sur Windows Terminal (dk.exe) et WSL, matrice minimale décidée par l'utilisateur : les 4 ExecProcess, l'espace dans chaque formulaire, le collage et les couleurs.

Contexte

Effort : L. Priorité : Must. Dépendances (bloquée par) : DEVDESK-197 (Go ≥ 1.26.8, S0), DEVDESK-199 et DEVDESK-200 (garde-fous sur v1, S1), DEVDESK-198 (spike). Les relations Plane (blocked_by) ne sont pas disponibles sur cette instance (404) : dépendances posées ici, dans le texte. Bloque : DEVDESK-207, DEVDESK-208, DEVDESK-209, DEVDESK-210, DEVDESK-211, DEVDESK-212 et les stories F5 et F6. Entrée : .claude/plans/charm-v2-impact.md (§1, §2, §4).

Décisions de l'utilisateur (2026-11-09) : migration ATOMIQUE en une seule PR, en remplacement des 6 lots sur une branche charm-v2 (stories DEVDESK-202 à 206 annulées, leur contenu est fusionné ici) ; architecture des vues : option C ; matrice de test minimale Windows Terminal + WSL ; pas d'usage SSH ni conteneur. Inclus : nouveau moteur de rendu et sync, profil couleur géré par Bubble Tea, routage de PasteMsg, "space" centralisé, viewport ←/→ désactivé, vigilance sur les largeurs. Ignorés : clavier Kitty / ctrl+shift, vrai curseur, souris, OSC 7501, nouveautés du viewport. Fonctionnalités reportées : stories de suivi du module.

content.content:
1	# Spike DEVDESK-198: Charm v2 migration (Bubble Tea, Bubbles, Lip Gloss, ntcharts)
2	
3	2026-11-10, Linux, Go 1.27.3. Base: `origin/main` at 63ebd72 (DEVDESK-197, 199, 200 merged).
4	Experiment code: branch `spike/charm-v2-code` (commit 217b389), **to be discarded, never merged**. This report is the only deliverable.
5	Pinned versions (not reopened): `charm.land/bubbletea/v2` v2.1.1, `charm.land/bubbles/v2` v2.2.1, `charm.land/lipgloss/v2` v2.0.6, `github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi` v0.11.9, `github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2` v2.9.0 (exact module path confirmed with `go list -m`; its `go.mod` requires bubbletea v2.1.1 and lipgloss v2.0.6, no `replace`). `go mod tidy` also pulled `go-runewidth` v0.0.16 to v0.0.31 and `colorprofile` v0.4.3.
6	
7	Method: sed the imports, let the compiler lead, fix by category. The spike ended **with everything compiling and `go test ./...` green** (run once, `-timeout 100s`; `go vet ./...` clean). The only deleted tests are the three of `internal/ui/testutil` (`keys_test.go`, `source_guard_test.go`, `testutil_test.go`) and `colorprofile_test.go`, which test v1 APIs and are to be rewritten (see criteria 4 and 5). Not run: `mise run lint`, `test-race` (needs cgo), the app in a real terminal.
8	
9	## Summary
10	
11	| # | Criterion | Verdict | One line |
12	|---|---|---|---|
13	| 1 | Imports on theme, datatable, about | OK | Mechanical. datatable: 0 production line beyond imports; theme: 4 logic spots; about: 1 method. The plan's counts hold, with two corrections (`termenv`, tests) |
14	| 2 | Palette `color.Color` | OK with reserve | 91 type sites (13 calls stay valid), 3 logic spots; Rule 119 holds; **`lipgloss.Color("")` is `NoColor` whose `RGBA()` is opaque black** and an invalid hex is silently `NoColor` |
15	| 3 | `Render()` + `View() tea.View` + `Screen` | OK | Compiles, **0 `handle*` signature changed** (271 of them, 429 `(tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` returns). Cost: 13 `.(Screen)` assertions in the router, tests renamed to `Render()` |
16	| 4 | Colour profile | OK with reserve | `tea.WithColorProfile` verified on a real `tea.Program`. 13 test files with termenv was really 3; **7 tests silently depended on the Ascii profile** |
17	| 5 | `testutil.Msgs` and `tea.Sequence` | OK | Reflection works unchanged: `sequenceMsg` is still `[]tea.Cmd` |
18	| 6 | ntcharts v2 sparkline | OK | One import line changed; `WithStyle(lipgloss.Style)` (v2); dashboard tests green |
19	| 7 | Rules 125 / 116, runewidth vs engine | OK with reserve | Layout byte-identical to v1 at 3 sizes. The engine's width depends on terminal mode 2027: **cannot be verified without a real terminal** |
20	| 8 | Viewport keys, `PasteMsg` | OK with reserve | Viewport: no change needed. **Paste is lost by the router and by every `KeyMsg`-gated field** (fixed in the router and `FilterBar`; ~34 sites remain to audit) |
21	| 9 | Commit split and effort | OK, adjusted | The seven commits and their order are those of `charm-v2-impact.md` §4; only their content is refined (sizes, what goes where); effort L confirmed (2 to 3 days of coding, plus manual terminal checks) |
22	
23	## 1. Imports on theme, datatable, about
24	
25	Counts on `main` (63ebd72). Method: `git grep -l '"github.com/charmbracelet/<pkg>"' 63ebd72 -- '*.go' | wc -l` for files (the bubbletea figure includes the two guard tests that quote the path as a string; a reviewer recount gave 258, so treat it as 257 to 258); `git grep -nP 'lipgloss\.Color\b(?!\()' 63ebd72 -- '*.go' ':!*_test.go'` for type sites (91; a reviewer recount gave 93, difference not explained, so 91 to 93) and the same without the lookahead trick (`lipgloss\.Color\(`) for calls (13); `git grep -n '\.(Screen)' spike/charm-v2-code -- 'internal/app/*.go' ':!*_test.go'` for assertions (13). Against §1 of `charm-v2-impact.md`:
26	
27	| Import | Plan | Measured |
28	|---|---|---|
29	| bubbletea | 239 files | 257 files (tests included) |
30	| lipgloss | 147 | 150 |
31	| bubbles spinner / textinput / table / viewport / key | 39 / 26 / 21 / 6 / 1 | 39 / 26 / 21 / 6 / 1 (identical) |
32	| x/ansi | 52 `ansi.*` | 53 imports |
33	| `termenv` | 13 test files | **3 files** (DEVDESK-199 funnelled it into `internal/testutil/colorprofile`; 50 callers of that helper stay unchanged) |
34	
35	One `sed` over the whole repo (376 files) replaced them. Also needed: two `string`-literal fixes, because the sed hit import paths quoted in two guard tests.
36	
37	What compiles and what breaks, per package, after the import swap only:
38	
39	| Package | Production code | Tests |
40	|---|---|---|
41	| `theme` | `colors.go`: 76 declarations `lipgloss.Color` to `color.Color` (type, mechanical). 15 more type sites elsewhere. `contrast.go`, `tokencolors.go` (read hex from the string): rewritten. `StyleTextInput` (textinput styles): rewritten. `manager.go`: **0 change** (`lipgloss.Color(hex)` is now a function and still compiles) | 72 compile errors in 13 files: 37 string constants given as `color.Color`, ~12 `string(c)`, 8 `lipgloss.TerminalColor`, rest `string` literals. Fixed with a 40-line script (wrap in `lipgloss.Color(...)`, `string(c)` to `theme.Hex(c)`). 1 failing test: the SGR reset is now `\x1b[m`, not `\x1b[0m` |
42	| `datatable` | **0 line** (builds as is, it does not use `bubbles/table` rendering) | compiles after `testutil` is ported; 4 tests fail until 8 literals `"\x1b[0m"` become `"\x1b[m"` |
43	| `about` | `View() string` becomes `Render() string` plus a 1-line `View() tea.View` | 3 `.View()` to `.Render()`; 1 test (see criterion 4) |
44	| `components` (dependency) | 2 sites `textinput.Width = n` to `SetWidth(n)` (23 such sites repo-wide) | 14 lines |
45	
46	Whole repo, production code: 209 files, +747 / -623. Tests: 203 files, +1070 / -1585 (the deletions are the four removed test files). The compiler found everything except the five silent points listed in criteria 2, 4, 8 and below.
47	
48	**Silent points actually hit** (compiler-silent, caught by tests): the space key (`keymap.Space` is `" "` in v1; flipping that one constant to `"space"` took the failures from about 50 to 11, which is the DEVDESK-200 payoff); the paste (criterion 8); the SGR reset `\x1b[m` (9 literals in 6 test files: 8 in datatable, 1 regexp in theme; `overlay.go` already accepts both); 7 tests that assumed no ANSI (criterion 4).
49	
50	Mechanical changes beyond imports, with site counts: `WithWhitespaceBackground` to `WithWhitespaceStyle(NewStyle().Background(c))` 16 sites (exact match with the plan); `textinput` `.Width` 23; textinput style assignments 3 (`theme.StyleTextInput`, `setup/styles.go`, `paletteInputView`); viewport `New(w,h)` 4, `.Width/.Height/.YOffset` reads and writes about 50 (including tests); `tea.WithAltScreen` 2 (now `View.AltScreen`). `bubbles/table` and `spinner` needed **no** change. `tea.KeyMsg` stays compilable (it is now an interface matching press and release): 103 production sites still use it; it works but should become `tea.KeyPressMsg` (release events only exist with keyboard enhancements, which we do not request).
51	
52	## 2. Palette
53	
54	The criterion announced "12 sites outside tests". Those are the *calls* `lipgloss.Color("...")` (measured 13: 12 in `theme/manager.go` `ApplyTheme`/`applyColor`, 1 in `app_header.go`), which stay valid because `Color` is now a function. The ~91 are the *type* uses `lipgloss.Color` as a declared type (76 in the `colors.go` var block, 15 elsewhere), a different count that the compiler forces to `color.Color`; the plan's "12 sites" list never included the var block.
55	
56	Port (what I did): every `var Color… lipgloss.Color` becomes `color.Color` (`import "image/color"`). Semantic aliases (`ColorTableLineSelected`, `ColorSyntax*`, `ColorFooter*`, `IconColor`, `TokenColor`, `indicator.Color`, `cmdsuggest.Fg/Bg`) carry the same `color.Color`; an alias is an assignment, so `ApplyTheme` is unchanged.
57	
58	**Rule 119** (hex only in `colors.go`): holds. `colors.go` only declares; the hex strings live in `manager.go`'s `DefaultTheme` and theme files, and `ApplyTheme` calls `lipgloss.Color(hexString)` exactly as before. A grep for `#rrggbb` literals outside `manager.go`/`colors.go` finds comments only. The one addition is `theme.Hex(c color.Color) string` (formats `#rrggbb` or `none`), used by tests in place of `string(c)`; it produces hex, it does not hold any.
59	
60	`contrast.go` reads components through `RGBA()` (`uint32`, 16-bit, shift by 8), after a type check:
61	
62	```go
63	if _, ok := c.(color.RGBA); !ok { return error }   // only "#rgb"/"#rrggbb" come out as color.RGBA
64	r, g, b, _ := c.RGBA()
65	```
66	
67	Without the type check the old contract ("hex only, else error") is lost, because of the empty-colour semantics below. `TestContrast*`, `ColorDistance` pass; their "error" table (`"", "red", "12", "ffffff", "#ggg"...`) still errors, now because those values become `NoColor` or `ansi.BasicColor`.
68	
69	**Empty colour** (`iconcolors.go`, measured):
70	
71	| Input | v2 type | `RGBA()` | `Render` |
72	|---|---|---|---|
73	| `lipgloss.Color("")` | `lipgloss.NoColor` | **0 0 0 65535 (opaque black)** | no SGR emitted ("inherits", same effect as v1) |
74	| `Color("red")`, `Color("#ggg")` | `NoColor` (silently) | opaque black | none |
75	| `Color("#fff")` | `color.RGBA` | ok | 38;2 |
76	| `Color("12")` | `ansi.BasicColor` | palette | 38;5/ANSI |
77	| `NewStyle().GetForeground()` (unset) | `NoColor{}`, `== Color("")` is true | | |
78	
79	Consequences: (a) the rendering semantics of "no colour" are preserved, so the `IconColor` rule (unknown role falls back to `ColorText`, never the zero Color) still protects Rule 122 and `IconColor("nope") == ColorText` passes; (b) **anything reading components must type-check first**, because `NoColor.RGBA()` is black; (c) `app_header.go:190` (`GetForeground() != lipgloss.Color("")`) keeps working through interface equality; (d) **a typo in a theme hex is now silently no colour**, where `lipgloss.Color` kept the string; if `ApplyTheme` should reject it, validate at load (not done in the spike, flagged as a risk). Reserve: the `textinput` virtual cursor style is `NewStyle().Foreground(Cursor.Color)` only, so the cursor cell loses the old `Background(ColorBackground)` (Rule 115); visual check needed.
80	
81	## 3. Architecture: `Render() string` + `View() tea.View` + `Screen`
82	
83	Done as decided:
84	
85	```go
86	// each of the 17 views
87	func (m Model) Render() string { ... }                         // was View() string
88	func (m Model) View() tea.View { return tea.NewView(m.Render()) }
89	
90	// router
91	type Screen interface { tea.Model; Render() string }
92	views map[command.ViewType]Screen
93	func (a *App) View() tea.View { v := tea.NewView(a.Render()); v.AltScreen = true; return v }
94	```
95	
96	`main.go` loses `tea.WithAltScreen()`; the setup wizard (its own root program) sets `AltScreen` in its own `View`.
97	
98	Result: **compiles, and no `handle*` signature changed.** `grep` finds 271 `handle*(...) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` and 429 `(tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` returns in production code (the plan said ~480); the diff touches none of them (the only added one is `handlePasteMsg`). Reason: `tea.Model` is still satisfied by the view.
99	
100	What it costs:
101	- 17 views: 17 renames + 17 one-line wrappers (scripted).
102	- Router: `Update` of a view returns `tea.Model`, so every `a.views[x] = updated` needs `updated.(Screen)`: **13 sites** in `internal/app` (it panics if a view stops implementing `Render`). A helper `a.setView(name, tea.Model)` would centralise it; I did not.
103	- 5 fake views in `internal/app/*_test.go` (+2 program wrappers): rename plus wrapper; `router()`, `routerAt()`, `commanding()` take a `Screen`.
104	- Tests: `.View()` on a view model becomes `.Render()`. 450 `.View()` calls in 104 test files; a script renamed all in the 17 view packages and `internal/app`, then reverted the 115 that were components (`datatable`, `FilterBar`, forms, which keep `View() string`). Tests may equally call `View().Content` (a `string` field, set by `NewView`); `Render()` is shorter and does not allocate a `tea.View`. Recommendation: `Render()` in tests.
105	- Components (`datatable`, `components.*`, `status/components`) keep `View() string`, as planned. Guards keyed on the method name `View` do not exist (`grep '"View"'` finds one test map), so the AST guards (`TestNoTableViewRendersALoadingBody`, footer guards) are unaffected by the rename.
106	
107	## 4. Colour profile
108	
109	`lipgloss.SetColorProfile` is gone; `Style.Render` now always emits full colour (`\x1b[38;2;r;g;bm`). `internal/testutil/colorprofile` therefore keeps its API (`TrueColor(t)`, `Force()`) as **no-ops** (50 callers untouched) and its own test file is deleted; `termenv` leaves `go.mod`. `source_guard_test.go` still needs the same rule re-aimed ("no import of `colorprofile` other than the helper, no hand-built `tea.KeyPressMsg{}`").
110	
111	Replacement validated on a real `tea.Program` (`internal/app/spike_profile_test.go`, 3 cases, output captured in a buffer):
112	
113	| `tea.WithColorProfile(...)` | `38;2;` | `38;5;` | `38;` | alt screen `\x1b[?1049h` | bytes |
114	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
115	| TrueColor | yes | | | yes | 3499 |
116	| ANSI256 | no | yes | | yes | 2634 |
117	| Ascii | no | no | no | yes | 1402 |
118	
119	So downsampling happens at the output, and `View.AltScreen` replaces the program option. `ColorProfileMsg` is sent by the program after capability detection; the `main.go` `COLORTERM`/`WT_SESSION` workaround can become `tea.WithColorProfile(colorprofile.TrueColor)` when `WT_SESSION` is set (not changed in the spike; WSL/Windows Terminal not verified).
120	
121	Guards:
122	- `TestNoViewStylesItsOwnFooterMessage`: AST scan of function names containing `RenderFooter`/`InfoLine`/`InfoText`; passes unchanged, keeps its meaning.
123	- `TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString`: passes unchanged. Its doc comment lists two causes; **cause 2 (lipgloss `sync.Once` locking the profile at init) no longer exists**, cause 1 (string frozen on the default theme) remains and is enough to keep the test. Update the comment.
124	- datatable tests: all pass after the eight `\x1b[0m` literals. The Rule 116 tests (`TestSelectedRowWithEmojiMeasuresRenderedWidth`) pass with x/ansi v0.11.9.
125	- **Hidden dependency found**: 7 tests asserted "blank line" or "empty info line" on raw `Render()` output and passed only because `go test` had no TTY, hence the Ascii profile (`about_test.go` says so in a comment: "under `go test` lipgloss finds no TTY and emits none"). In v2 the same line is `ESC[38;2;…m   ESC[m`. Fixed with `ansi.Strip` in `about`, `configuration`, `dashboard`, `netdiag`, `oci_resources`, `security` (x2). These tests did not check what they claimed to; `ansi.Strip` is the right form.
126	
127	## 5. `testutil.Msgs` and `tea.Sequence`
128	
129	Works unchanged. bubbletea v2.1.1 still has `type sequenceMsg []Cmd` (unexported) and `type BatchMsg []Cmd` (exported); the reflection (`Kind()==Slice && Elem()==TypeFor[tea.Cmd]()`) matches as before. Tested: `Msgs(tea.Sequence(c(1), tea.Batch(c(2), c(3)), c(4)))` returns the four messages in order. No replacement needed. Risk to note: this relies on the type staying a `[]Cmd`; `internal/ui/testutil` should keep the test that fails if bubbletea changes it.
130	
131	Other `testutil` changes (one 60-line file rewritten, all of `Key`/`Type`/`Paste`/`IsText`/`Text`): `Key` returns `tea.KeyPressMsg{Code, Text, Mod}`; space is `{Code: KeySpace, Text: " "}` (its `String()` is `"space"`); `alt+x` must clear `Text` (otherwise `String()` returns `x`, found by a test); `shift+tab` is `{Code: KeyTab, Mod: ModShift}`; `Paste` is `tea.PasteMsg{Content}`. The 1295 `testutil.Key` call sites needed no change; 22 tests that name `tea.KeyMsg` kept compiling.
132	
133	## 6. ntcharts v2 sparkline
134	
135	OK. `internal/ui/dashboard/chart.go`: **one line** (the import path). All used API exists in `github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2/sparkline` v2.9.0: `New(w, h, opts...)`, `WithStyle(lipgloss.Style)` (lip gloss v2 type), `WithMaxValue`, `WithNoAutoMaxValue`, `PushAll`, `Draw`, `DrawBraille`, `Model.View() string`. Styles are `lipgloss.Style`, not a raw colour, so `color.Color` does not appear. The six chart tests (`TestEveryChartCellCarriesABackground`, `TestAChartLineIsExactlyTheColumnWidth`, …) pass.
136	
137	## 7. Rules 125 and 116, measure divergence
138	
139	Method: the same dump test run on `origin/main` (v1) and on the spike (v2), at 80x24, 120x40, 200x50, for (a) a datatable with an untitled `IconColumnWidth` (2) Nerd Font column (U+F07B, U+F0849, U+E725…) and rows holding VS16 emoji, flags, ZWJ, CJK, combining marks; (b) the viewer on a log with wide characters; (c) the setup wizard form. Per line: `ansi.StringWidth`, `runewidth.StringWidth` of the stripped text, and the text.
140	
141	- Layout (stripped text and `ansi.StringWidth` of every line): **identical v1 and v2 for the 9 dumps**. Table lines are all 78/118/198 cells (viewport minus the 2 border cells); Rule 116 holds, and `TestSelectedRowWithEmojiMeasuresRenderedWidth` is green. Rule 125 holds: the icon column is 2 cells, glyph plus one cell, with no clipping.
142	- The only v1/v2 difference is the `runewidth` figure of lines containing a flag: 77 vs 78 (go-runewidth v0.0.16 to v0.0.31 now counts regional-indicator pairs as 2).
143	- `runewidth` vs the engine's measure (`ansi.StringWidth`, grapheme) vs `ansi.StringWidthWc` (per-rune wcwidth):
144	
145	| String | grapheme | wcwidth | runewidth v0.0.31 |
146	|---|---|---|---|
147	| `a❤️x` | 4 | 3 | 3 |
148	| `✔️`, `🛡️` | 2 | 1 | 1 |
149	| flag FR | 2 | 2 | 2 |
150	| ZWJ family | 2 | **6** | 2 |
151	| Nerd Font glyph (PUA) | 1 | 1 | 1 |
152	| CJK, `e`+U+0301 | 6 / 1 | 6 / 1 | 6 / 1 |
153	
154	  So `datatable`'s `runewidth` agrees with the grapheme measure except for VS16 emoji (3 vs 4), the case the Rule 116 test pins. **Not verifiable here:** which method the renderer uses. In bubbletea v2.1.1 the cell renderer starts in per-rune width and switches to `ansi.GraphemeWidth` only when the terminal answers the DECRQM query for mode 2027 (`tea.go` handling of `ModeReportMsg`). On a terminal without 2027 (support in Windows Terminal, tmux, Terminal.app not checked) a VS16 emoji or a ZWJ sequence would be laid out with another width than `datatable` assumes, shifting the rest of the line. Mitigation if it shows: keep emoji out of columns, or measure with `ansi.StringWidthWc` when mode 2027 is absent. Needs a real terminal test.
155	- 19 `runewidth.*` call sites in 3 production files remain (not 37/10: the rest are tests).
156	
157	## 8. Viewport and paste
158	
159	**Viewport.** The criterion's hypothesis (←/→ scroll by default and must be disabled to respect Rule 135, where ←/→ change level or value) is **refuted for DevDesk**: the default does scroll horizontally in v2, but no viewport that would conflict ever receives ←/→, and the one that receives raw keys already has no Left/Right binding. Measured with `internal/app/spike_viewport_test.go`: a default v2 viewport scrolls horizontally on `right` (XOffset 6) and on `l`, and vertically on `j`. But only **one** viewport ever receives a raw key: the help overlay (`help_overlay.go:68`, `helpViewport.Update(msg)`), and it already installs `arrowOnlyScroll()`, whose `KeyMap` has no `Left`/`Right`. Test result: with that keymap, `left right h l j k space d u b f` leave X and Y at 0; `down` and `pgdown` still scroll. The other four viewports (app body, viewer, security and netdiag details) never get `Update`, they are driven with `SetYOffset`. So there is **nothing to disable**, contrary to the plan's "5 viewports". It is also not a v2 novelty: bubbles v0.21's `KeyMap` already has `Left`/`Right` (`left,h` / `right,l`), found in the module source. Keep the test, and the rule "a viewport that receives keys sets an explicit `KeyMap`".
160	
161	**Paste.** `tea.PasteMsg` does **not** reach the focused field by default: the router's `update` only switches on `tea.KeyMsg`. Four tests of DEVDESK-199 failed, as they were meant to: `TestPasteIntoCommandPaletteReachesTheField` (2 cases), `TestPasteWhileHelpIsOpenTriggersNothing`, and `TestTypedTextReachesTheFieldUnchanged/FilterBar`. Fixed in the spike:
162	- router: `case tea.PasteMsg: return a.handlePasteMsg(msg)`, 14 lines. Dropped during a context switch, help or context list; to `commandInput` in command mode; to the active view only when `inEditMode()`; else ignored. A paste can no longer fire `q`, `?` or `:` (Rule 111). `textinput` v2 turns newlines into spaces (`l1\nl2` gives `l1 l2`).
163	- `FilterBar.Update`: accept `tea.PasteMsg` next to `tea.KeyMsg`.
164	- **Still open**: 36 `msg.(tea.KeyMsg)` / `case tea.KeyMsg` gates in production code route text to inputs (30 files use `textinput` or `WrappedInput`). Every form or view with an edit mode must also accept `PasteMsg`. The existing paste tests cover the router, the palette, `FilterBar` and the components; the views' forms need one table-driven test each (add during S2).
165	
166	## Decisions for the migration story
167	
168	Taken by the user after this report:
169	1. `ApplyTheme` rejects an invalid hex at load time (a typo no longer degrades silently to `lipgloss.NoColor`, see criterion 2).
170	2. The `COLORTERM`/`WT_SESSION` workaround in `main.go` is replaced by `tea.WithColorProfile(colorprofile.TrueColor)` (see criterion 4).
171	
172	## 9. Conclusion: commit split and effort
173	
174	The order of the plan (§4, S2 a to g) is confirmed unchanged. What the spike changes is the content of each commit, not the order:
175	1. **The build cannot be compiled between commits anyway** (all of `charm.land/*/v2` at once), so the "commits" are review units, not bisect points; say so in the PR. Squashing is not advised, reviewers need the split.
176	2. Content and size per commit:
177	
178	| # | Commit | Content | Measured size |
179	|---|---|---|---|
180	| a | `theme` | `color.Color`, `contrast`/`tokencolors` via `RGBA()` + type check, `theme.Hex`, `StyleTextInput`, SGR reset literals | ~25 files |
181	| b | keys | `testutil` rewritten, `keymap.Space = "space"`, `tea.KeyMsg` to `tea.KeyPressMsg` (103 sites, optional but wanted), `source_guard_test` and `testutil` tests ported | ~10 files + the 103 sites |
182	| c | router | `Screen`, `Render`/`View` on 17 views + `App`, `AltScreen`, `.(Screen)` x13, `handlePasteMsg`, tests renamed to `Render()` | ~120 files, mostly scripted |
183	| d | bubbles | `textinput` `SetWidth` x23 and `SetStyles` x3, viewport options and accessors, `WithWhitespaceStyle` x16, paste in forms (36 gates), explicit `KeyMap` rule | ~60 files |
184	| e | ntcharts + ansi | import line, `go mod tidy` | 2 files |
185	| f | colour profile | `colorprofile` helper as no-op, drop `termenv`, `ansi.Strip` in the 7 tests, `main.go` `WithColorProfile` if `WT_SESSION` | ~15 files |
186	| g | docs | Rules 111 ("v1.3.10 does not enable"), 115 (cursor), 122, `app-shell.md`, `configuration.md`, `ui-components.md`; `TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString` comment | |
187	
188	3. Effort: L confirmed. The spike (mostly scripted) touched 209 production and 203 test files with about 100 lines of real logic (theme 4 spots, testutil 60 lines, router 15, `StyleTextInput` x3). Estimated 2 to 3 days to land cleanly (lint, `test-race`, review of the diff), plus half a day of manual checks.
189	
190	**Remaining risks and unknowns (not verified here):**
191	- Real terminals: mode 2027/2026 negotiation, WSL and Windows Terminal colours, Nerd Font rendering, tmux. Nothing was run in a TTY; only a captured `tea.Program` output.
192	- The four `tea.ExecProcess` sites (container shell `T`, OCI `-it`, pager `V`, workspace terminal): not exercised; API unchanged on paper.
193	- Visual check of the textinput virtual cursor background (Rule 115) and the footer filter bar.
194	- `TestMeasureRedrawCost` baseline not compared (the new renderer's cost is a claimed gain of the plan, not measured).

197	- Router assertions `.(Screen)` (13) can panic at runtime; consider a typed `setView`.
198	- Paste in the 36 `KeyMsg`-gated views (criterion 8).
199	- `go-runewidth` moved to v0.0.31 through tidy, changing flag widths in the 19 remaining `runewidth` sites.

# Spike DEVDESK-198: Charm v2 migration (Bubble Tea, Bubbles, Lip Gloss, ntcharts)

2026-11-10, Linux, Go 1.27.3. Base: `origin/main` at 63ebd72 (DEVDESK-197, 199, 200 merged).
Experiment code: branch `spike/charm-v2-code` (commit 217b389), **to be discarded, never merged**. This report is the only deliverable.
Pinned versions (not reopened): `charm.land/bubbletea/v2` v2.1.1, `charm.land/bubbles/v2` v2.2.1, `charm.land/lipgloss/v2` v2.0.6, `github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi` v0.11.9, `github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2` v2.9.0 (exact module path confirmed with `go list -m`; its `go.mod` requires bubbletea v2.1.1 and lipgloss v2.0.6, no `replace`). `go mod tidy` also pulled `go-runewidth` v0.0.16 to v0.0.31 and `colorprofile` v0.4.3.

Method: sed the imports, let the compiler lead, fix by category. The spike ended **with everything compiling and `go test ./...` green** (run once, `-timeout 100s`; `go vet ./...` clean). The only deleted tests are the three of `internal/ui/testutil` (`keys_test.go`, `source_guard_test.go`, `testutil_test.go`) and `colorprofile_test.go`, which test v1 APIs and are to be rewritten (see criteria 4 and 5). Not run: `mise run lint`, `test-race` (needs cgo), the app in a real terminal.

## Summary

| # | Criterion | Verdict | One line |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Imports on theme, datatable, about | OK | Mechanical. datatable: 0 production line beyond imports; theme: 4 logic spots; about: 1 method. The plan's counts hold, with two corrections (`termenv`, tests) |
| 2 | Palette `color.Color` | OK with reserve | 91 type sites (13 calls stay valid), 3 logic spots; Rule 119 holds; **`lipgloss.Color("")` is `NoColor` whose `RGBA()` is opaque black** and an invalid hex is silently `NoColor` |
| 3 | `Render()` + `View() tea.View` + `Screen` | OK | Compiles, **0 `handle*` signature changed** (271 of them, 429 `(tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` returns). Cost: 13 `.(Screen)` assertions in the router, tests renamed to `Render()` |
| 4 | Colour profile | OK with reserve | `tea.WithColorProfile` verified on a real `tea.Program`. 13 test files with termenv was really 3; **7 tests silently depended on the Ascii profile** |
| 5 | `testutil.Msgs` and `tea.Sequence` | OK | Reflection works unchanged: `sequenceMsg` is still `[]tea.Cmd` |
| 6 | ntcharts v2 sparkline | OK | One import line changed; `WithStyle(lipgloss.Style)` (v2); dashboard tests green |
| 7 | Rules 125 / 116, runewidth vs engine | OK with reserve | Layout byte-identical to v1 at 3 sizes. The engine's width depends on terminal mode 2027: **cannot be verified without a real terminal** |
| 8 | Viewport keys, `PasteMsg` | OK with reserve | Viewport: no change needed. **Paste is lost by the router and by every `KeyMsg`-gated field** (fixed in the router and `FilterBar`; ~34 sites remain to audit) |
| 9 | Commit split and effort | OK, adjusted | The seven commits and their order are those of `charm-v2-impact.md` §4; only their content is refined (sizes, what goes where); effort L confirmed (2 to 3 days of coding, plus manual terminal checks) |

## 1. Imports on theme, datatable, about

Counts on `main` (63ebd72). Method: `git grep -l '"github.com/charmbracelet/<pkg>"' 63ebd72 -- '*.go' | wc -l` for files (the bubbletea figure includes the two guard tests that quote the path as a string; a reviewer recount gave 258, so treat it as 257 to 258); `git grep -nP 'lipgloss\.Color\b(?!\()' 63ebd72 -- '*.go' ':!*_test.go'` for type sites (91; a reviewer recount gave 93, difference not explained, so 91 to 93) and the same without the lookahead trick (`lipgloss\.Color\(`) for calls (13); `git grep -n '\.(Screen)' spike/charm-v2-code -- 'internal/app/*.go' ':!*_test.go'` for assertions (13). Against §1 of `charm-v2-impact.md`:

| Import | Plan | Measured |
|---|---|---|
| bubbletea | 239 files | 257 files (tests included) |
| lipgloss | 147 | 150 |
| bubbles spinner / textinput / table / viewport / key | 39 / 26 / 21 / 6 / 1 | 39 / 26 / 21 / 6 / 1 (identical) |
| x/ansi | 52 `ansi.*` | 53 imports |
| `termenv` | 13 test files | **3 files** (DEVDESK-199 funnelled it into `internal/testutil/colorprofile`; 50 callers of that helper stay unchanged) |

One `sed` over the whole repo (376 files) replaced them. Also needed: two `string`-literal fixes, because the sed hit import paths quoted in two guard tests.

What compiles and what breaks, per package, after the import swap only:

| Package | Production code | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| `theme` | `colors.go`: 76 declarations `lipgloss.Color` to `color.Color` (type, mechanical). 15 more type sites elsewhere. `contrast.go`, `tokencolors.go` (read hex from the string): rewritten. `StyleTextInput` (textinput styles): rewritten. `manager.go`: **0 change** (`lipgloss.Color(hex)` is now a function and still compiles) | 72 compile errors in 13 files: 37 string constants given as `color.Color`, ~12 `string(c)`, 8 `lipgloss.TerminalColor`, rest `string` literals. Fixed with a 40-line script (wrap in `lipgloss.Color(...)`, `string(c)` to `theme.Hex(c)`). 1 failing test: the SGR reset is now `\x1b[m`, not `\x1b[0m` |
| `datatable` | **0 line** (builds as is, it does not use `bubbles/table` rendering) | compiles after `testutil` is ported; 4 tests fail until 8 literals `"\x1b[0m"` become `"\x1b[m"` |
| `about` | `View() string` becomes `Render() string` plus a 1-line `View() tea.View` | 3 `.View()` to `.Render()`; 1 test (see criterion 4) |
| `components` (dependency) | 2 sites `textinput.Width = n` to `SetWidth(n)` (23 such sites repo-wide) | 14 lines |

Whole repo, production code: 209 files, +747 / -623. Tests: 203 files, +1070 / -1585 (the deletions are the four removed test files). The compiler found everything except the five silent points listed in criteria 2, 4, 8 and below.

**Silent points actually hit** (compiler-silent, caught by tests): the space key (`keymap.Space` is `" "` in v1; flipping that one constant to `"space"` took the failures from about 50 to 11, which is the DEVDESK-200 payoff); the paste (criterion 8); the SGR reset `\x1b[m` (9 literals in 6 test files: 8 in datatable, 1 regexp in theme; `overlay.go` already accepts both); 7 tests that assumed no ANSI (criterion 4).

Mechanical changes beyond imports, with site counts: `WithWhitespaceBackground` to `WithWhitespaceStyle(NewStyle().Background(c))` 16 sites (exact match with the plan); `textinput` `.Width` 23; textinput style assignments 3 (`theme.StyleTextInput`, `setup/styles.go`, `paletteInputView`); viewport `New(w,h)` 4, `.Width/.Height/.YOffset` reads and writes about 50 (including tests); `tea.WithAltScreen` 2 (now `View.AltScreen`). `bubbles/table` and `spinner` needed **no** change. `tea.KeyMsg` stays compilable (it is now an interface matching press and release): 103 production sites still use it; it works but should become `tea.KeyPressMsg` (release events only exist with keyboard enhancements, which we do not request).

## 2. Palette

The criterion announced "12 sites outside tests". Those are the *calls* `lipgloss.Color("...")` (measured 13: 12 in `theme/manager.go` `ApplyTheme`/`applyColor`, 1 in `app_header.go`), which stay valid because `Color` is now a function. The ~91 are the *type* uses `lipgloss.Color` as a declared type (76 in the `colors.go` var block, 15 elsewhere), a different count that the compiler forces to `color.Color`; the plan's "12 sites" list never included the var block.

Port (what I did): every `var Color… lipgloss.Color` becomes `color.Color` (`import "image/color"`). Semantic aliases (`ColorTableLineSelected`, `ColorSyntax*`, `ColorFooter*`, `IconColor`, `TokenColor`, `indicator.Color`, `cmdsuggest.Fg/Bg`) carry the same `color.Color`; an alias is an assignment, so `ApplyTheme` is unchanged.

**Rule 119** (hex only in `colors.go`): holds. `colors.go` only declares; the hex strings live in `manager.go`'s `DefaultTheme` and theme files, and `ApplyTheme` calls `lipgloss.Color(hexString)` exactly as before. A grep for `#rrggbb` literals outside `manager.go`/`colors.go` finds comments only. The one addition is `theme.Hex(c color.Color) string` (formats `#rrggbb` or `none`), used by tests in place of `string(c)`; it produces hex, it does not hold any.

`contrast.go` reads components through `RGBA()` (`uint32`, 16-bit, shift by 8), after a type check:

```go
if _, ok := c.(color.RGBA); !ok { return error }   // only "#rgb"/"#rrggbb" come out as color.RGBA
r, g, b, _ := c.RGBA()
```

Without the type check the old contract ("hex only, else error") is lost, because of the empty-colour semantics below. `TestContrast*`, `ColorDistance` pass; their "error" table (`"", "red", "12", "ffffff", "#ggg"...`) still errors, now because those values become `NoColor` or `ansi.BasicColor`.

**Empty colour** (`iconcolors.go`, measured):

| Input | v2 type | `RGBA()` | `Render` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lipgloss.Color("")` | `lipgloss.NoColor` | **0 0 0 65535 (opaque black)** | no SGR emitted ("inherits", same effect as v1) |
| `Color("red")`, `Color("#ggg")` | `NoColor` (silently) | opaque black | none |
| `Color("#fff")` | `color.RGBA` | ok | 38;2 |
| `Color("12")` | `ansi.BasicColor` | palette | 38;5/ANSI |
| `NewStyle().GetForeground()` (unset) | `NoColor{}`, `== Color("")` is true | | |

Consequences: (a) the rendering semantics of "no colour" are preserved, so the `IconColor` rule (unknown role falls back to `ColorText`, never the zero Color) still protects Rule 122 and `IconColor("nope") == ColorText` passes; (b) **anything reading components must type-check first**, because `NoColor.RGBA()` is black; (c) `app_header.go:190` (`GetForeground() != lipgloss.Color("")`) keeps working through interface equality; (d) **a typo in a theme hex is now silently no colour**, where `lipgloss.Color` kept the string; if `ApplyTheme` should reject it, validate at load (not done in the spike, flagged as a risk). Reserve: the `textinput` virtual cursor style is `NewStyle().Foreground(Cursor.Color)` only, so the cursor cell loses the old `Background(ColorBackground)` (Rule 115); visual check needed.

## 3. Architecture: `Render() string` + `View() tea.View` + `Screen`

Done as decided:

```go
// each of the 17 views
func (m Model) Render() string { ... }                         // was View() string
func (m Model) View() tea.View { return tea.NewView(m.Render()) }

// router
type Screen interface { tea.Model; Render() string }
views map[command.ViewType]Screen
func (a *App) View() tea.View { v := tea.NewView(a.Render()); v.AltScreen = true; return v }
```

`main.go` loses `tea.WithAltScreen()`; the setup wizard (its own root program) sets `AltScreen` in its own `View`.

Result: **compiles, and no `handle*` signature changed.** `grep` finds 271 `handle*(...) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` and 429 `(tea.Model, tea.Cmd)` returns in production code (the plan said ~480); the diff touches none of them (the only added one is `handlePasteMsg`). Reason: `tea.Model` is still satisfied by the view.

What it costs:
- 17 views: 17 renames + 17 one-line wrappers (scripted).
- Router: `Update` of a view returns `tea.Model`, so every `a.views[x] = updated` needs `updated.(Screen)`: **13 sites** in `internal/app` (it panics if a view stops implementing `Render`). A helper `a.setView(name, tea.Model)` would centralise it; I did not.
- 5 fake views in `internal/app/*_test.go` (+2 program wrappers): rename plus wrapper; `router()`, `routerAt()`, `commanding()` take a `Screen`.
- Tests: `.View()` on a view model becomes `.Render()`. 450 `.View()` calls in 104 test files; a script renamed all in the 17 view packages and `internal/app`, then reverted the 115 that were components (`datatable`, `FilterBar`, forms, which keep `View() string`). Tests may equally call `View().Content` (a `string` field, set by `NewView`); `Render()` is shorter and does not allocate a `tea.View`. Recommendation: `Render()` in tests.
- Components (`datatable`, `components.*`, `status/components`) keep `View() string`, as planned. Guards keyed on the method name `View` do not exist (`grep '"View"'` finds one test map), so the AST guards (`TestNoTableViewRendersALoadingBody`, footer guards) are unaffected by the rename.

## 4. Colour profile

`lipgloss.SetColorProfile` is gone; `Style.Render` now always emits full colour (`\x1b[38;2;r;g;bm`). `internal/testutil/colorprofile` therefore keeps its API (`TrueColor(t)`, `Force()`) as **no-ops** (50 callers untouched) and its own test file is deleted; `termenv` leaves `go.mod`. `source_guard_test.go` still needs the same rule re-aimed ("no import of `colorprofile` other than the helper, no hand-built `tea.KeyPressMsg{}`").

Replacement validated on a real `tea.Program` (`internal/app/spike_profile_test.go`, 3 cases, output captured in a buffer):

| `tea.WithColorProfile(...)` | `38;2;` | `38;5;` | `38;` | alt screen `\x1b[?1049h` | bytes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TrueColor | yes | | | yes | 3499 |
| ANSI256 | no | yes | | yes | 2634 |
| Ascii | no | no | no | yes | 1402 |

So downsampling happens at the output, and `View.AltScreen` replaces the program option. `ColorProfileMsg` is sent by the program after capability detection; the `main.go` `COLORTERM`/`WT_SESSION` workaround can become `tea.WithColorProfile(colorprofile.TrueColor)` when `WT_SESSION` is set (not changed in the spike; WSL/Windows Terminal not verified).

Guards:
- `TestNoViewStylesItsOwnFooterMessage`: AST scan of function names containing `RenderFooter`/`InfoLine`/`InfoText`; passes unchanged, keeps its meaning.
- `TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString`: passes unchanged. Its doc comment lists two causes; **cause 2 (lipgloss `sync.Once` locking the profile at init) no longer exists**, cause 1 (string frozen on the default theme) remains and is enough to keep the test. Update the comment.
- datatable tests: all pass after the eight `\x1b[0m` literals. The Rule 116 tests (`TestSelectedRowWithEmojiMeasuresRenderedWidth`) pass with x/ansi v0.11.9.
- **Hidden dependency found**: 7 tests asserted "blank line" or "empty info line" on raw `Render()` output and passed only because `go test` had no TTY, hence the Ascii profile (`about_test.go` says so in a comment: "under `go test` lipgloss finds no TTY and emits none"). In v2 the same line is `ESC[38;2;…m   ESC[m`. Fixed with `ansi.Strip` in `about`, `configuration`, `dashboard`, `netdiag`, `oci_resources`, `security` (x2). These tests did not check what they claimed to; `ansi.Strip` is the right form.

## 5. `testutil.Msgs` and `tea.Sequence`

Works unchanged. bubbletea v2.1.1 still has `type sequenceMsg []Cmd` (unexported) and `type BatchMsg []Cmd` (exported); the reflection (`Kind()==Slice && Elem()==TypeFor[tea.Cmd]()`) matches as before. Tested: `Msgs(tea.Sequence(c(1), tea.Batch(c(2), c(3)), c(4)))` returns the four messages in order. No replacement needed. Risk to note: this relies on the type staying a `[]Cmd`; `internal/ui/testutil` should keep the test that fails if bubbletea changes it.

Other `testutil` changes (one 60-line file rewritten, all of `Key`/`Type`/`Paste`/`IsText`/`Text`): `Key` returns `tea.KeyPressMsg{Code, Text, Mod}`; space is `{Code: KeySpace, Text: " "}` (its `String()` is `"space"`); `alt+x` must clear `Text` (otherwise `String()` returns `x`, found by a test); `shift+tab` is `{Code: KeyTab, Mod: ModShift}`; `Paste` is `tea.PasteMsg{Content}`. The 1295 `testutil.Key` call sites needed no change; 22 tests that name `tea.KeyMsg` kept compiling.

## 6. ntcharts v2 sparkline

OK. `internal/ui/dashboard/chart.go`: **one line** (the import path). All used API exists in `github.com/NimbleMarkets/ntcharts/v2/sparkline` v2.9.0: `New(w, h, opts...)`, `WithStyle(lipgloss.Style)` (lip gloss v2 type), `WithMaxValue`, `WithNoAutoMaxValue`, `PushAll`, `Draw`, `DrawBraille`, `Model.View() string`. Styles are `lipgloss.Style`, not a raw colour, so `color.Color` does not appear. The six chart tests (`TestEveryChartCellCarriesABackground`, `TestAChartLineIsExactlyTheColumnWidth`, …) pass.

## 7. Rules 125 and 116, measure divergence

Method: the same dump test run on `origin/main` (v1) and on the spike (v2), at 80x24, 120x40, 200x50, for (a) a datatable with an untitled `IconColumnWidth` (2) Nerd Font column (U+F07B, U+F0849, U+E725…) and rows holding VS16 emoji, flags, ZWJ, CJK, combining marks; (b) the viewer on a log with wide characters; (c) the setup wizard form. Per line: `ansi.StringWidth`, `runewidth.StringWidth` of the stripped text, and the text.

- Layout (stripped text and `ansi.StringWidth` of every line): **identical v1 and v2 for the 9 dumps**. Table lines are all 78/118/198 cells (viewport minus the 2 border cells); Rule 116 holds, and `TestSelectedRowWithEmojiMeasuresRenderedWidth` is green. Rule 125 holds: the icon column is 2 cells, glyph plus one cell, with no clipping.
- The only v1/v2 difference is the `runewidth` figure of lines containing a flag: 77 vs 78 (go-runewidth v0.0.16 to v0.0.31 now counts regional-indicator pairs as 2).
- `runewidth` vs the engine's measure (`ansi.StringWidth`, grapheme) vs `ansi.StringWidthWc` (per-rune wcwidth):

| String | grapheme | wcwidth | runewidth v0.0.31 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a❤️x` | 4 | 3 | 3 |
| `✔️`, `🛡️` | 2 | 1 | 1 |
| flag FR | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| ZWJ family | 2 | **6** | 2 |
| Nerd Font glyph (PUA) | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| CJK, `e`+U+0301 | 6 / 1 | 6 / 1 | 6 / 1 |

  So `datatable`'s `runewidth` agrees with the grapheme measure except for VS16 emoji (3 vs 4), the case the Rule 116 test pins. **Not verifiable here:** which method the renderer uses. In bubbletea v2.1.1 the cell renderer starts in per-rune width and switches to `ansi.GraphemeWidth` only when the terminal answers the DECRQM query for mode 2027 (`tea.go` handling of `ModeReportMsg`). On a terminal without 2027 (support in Windows Terminal, tmux, Terminal.app not checked) a VS16 emoji or a ZWJ sequence would be laid out with another width than `datatable` assumes, shifting the rest of the line. Mitigation if it shows: keep emoji out of columns, or measure with `ansi.StringWidthWc` when mode 2027 is absent. Needs a real terminal test.
- 19 `runewidth.*` call sites in 3 production files remain (not 37/10: the rest are tests).

## 8. Viewport and paste

**Viewport.** The criterion's hypothesis (←/→ scroll by default and must be disabled to respect Rule 135, where ←/→ change level or value) is **refuted for DevDesk**: the default does scroll horizontally in v2, but no viewport that would conflict ever receives ←/→, and the one that receives raw keys already has no Left/Right binding. Measured with `internal/app/spike_viewport_test.go`: a default v2 viewport scrolls horizontally on `right` (XOffset 6) and on `l`, and vertically on `j`. But only **one** viewport ever receives a raw key: the help overlay (`help_overlay.go:68`, `helpViewport.Update(msg)`), and it already installs `arrowOnlyScroll()`, whose `KeyMap` has no `Left`/`Right`. Test result: with that keymap, `left right h l j k space d u b f` leave X and Y at 0; `down` and `pgdown` still scroll. The other four viewports (app body, viewer, security and netdiag details) never get `Update`, they are driven with `SetYOffset`. So there is **nothing to disable**, contrary to the plan's "5 viewports". It is also not a v2 novelty: bubbles v0.21's `KeyMap` already has `Left`/`Right` (`left,h` / `right,l`), found in the module source. Keep the test, and the rule "a viewport that receives keys sets an explicit `KeyMap`".

**Paste.** `tea.PasteMsg` does **not** reach the focused field by default: the router's `update` only switches on `tea.KeyMsg`. Four tests of DEVDESK-199 failed, as they were meant to: `TestPasteIntoCommandPaletteReachesTheField` (2 cases), `TestPasteWhileHelpIsOpenTriggersNothing`, and `TestTypedTextReachesTheFieldUnchanged/FilterBar`. Fixed in the spike:
- router: `case tea.PasteMsg: return a.handlePasteMsg(msg)`, 14 lines. Dropped during a context switch, help or context list; to `commandInput` in command mode; to the active view only when `inEditMode()`; else ignored. A paste can no longer fire `q`, `?` or `:` (Rule 111). `textinput` v2 turns newlines into spaces (`l1\nl2` gives `l1 l2`).
- `FilterBar.Update`: accept `tea.PasteMsg` next to `tea.KeyMsg`.
- **Still open**: 36 `msg.(tea.KeyMsg)` / `case tea.KeyMsg` gates in production code route text to inputs (30 files use `textinput` or `WrappedInput`). Every form or view with an edit mode must also accept `PasteMsg`. The existing paste tests cover the router, the palette, `FilterBar` and the components; the views' forms need one table-driven test each (add during S2).

## Decisions for the migration story

Taken by the user after this report:
1. `ApplyTheme` rejects an invalid hex at load time (a typo no longer degrades silently to `lipgloss.NoColor`, see criterion 2).
2. The `COLORTERM`/`WT_SESSION` workaround in `main.go` is replaced by `tea.WithColorProfile(colorprofile.TrueColor)` (see criterion 4).

## 9. Conclusion: commit split and effort

The order of the plan (§4, S2 a to g) is confirmed unchanged. What the spike changes is the content of each commit, not the order:
1. **The build cannot be compiled between commits anyway** (all of `charm.land/*/v2` at once), so the "commits" are review units, not bisect points; say so in the PR. Squashing is not advised, reviewers need the split.
2. Content and size per commit:

| # | Commit | Content | Measured size |
|---|---|---|---|
| a | `theme` | `color.Color`, `contrast`/`tokencolors` via `RGBA()` + type check, `theme.Hex`, `StyleTextInput`, SGR reset literals | ~25 files |
| b | keys | `testutil` rewritten, `keymap.Space = "space"`, `tea.KeyMsg` to `tea.KeyPressMsg` (103 sites, optional but wanted), `source_guard_test` and `testutil` tests ported | ~10 files + the 103 sites |
| c | router | `Screen`, `Render`/`View` on 17 views + `App`, `AltScreen`, `.(Screen)` x13, `handlePasteMsg`, tests renamed to `Render()` | ~120 files, mostly scripted |
| d | bubbles | `textinput` `SetWidth` x23 and `SetStyles` x3, viewport options and accessors, `WithWhitespaceStyle` x16, paste in forms (36 gates), explicit `KeyMap` rule | ~60 files |
| e | ntcharts + ansi | import line, `go mod tidy` | 2 files |
| f | colour profile | `colorprofile` helper as no-op, drop `termenv`, `ansi.Strip` in the 7 tests, `main.go` `WithColorProfile` if `WT_SESSION` | ~15 files |
| g | docs | Rules 111 ("v1.3.10 does not enable"), 115 (cursor), 122, `app-shell.md`, `configuration.md`, `ui-components.md`; `TestNoPackageLevelVarRendersAString` comment | |

3. Effort: L confirmed. The spike (mostly scripted) touched 209 production and 203 test files with about 100 lines of real logic (theme 4 spots, testutil 60 lines, router 15, `StyleTextInput` x3). Estimated 2 to 3 days to land cleanly (lint, `test-race`, review of the diff), plus half a day of manual checks.

**Remaining risks and unknowns (not verified here):**
- Real terminals: mode 2027/2026 negotiation, WSL and Windows Terminal colours, Nerd Font rendering, tmux. Nothing was run in a TTY; only a captured `tea.Program` output.
- The four `tea.ExecProcess` sites (container shell `T`, OCI `-it`, pager `V`, workspace terminal): not exercised; API unchanged on paper.
- Visual check of the textinput virtual cursor background (Rule 115) and the footer filter bar.
- `TestMeasureRedrawCost` baseline not compared (the new renderer's cost is a claimed gain of the plan, not measured).
- `golangci-lint` and `test-race` not run on the spike.
- Silent `NoColor` on a bad theme hex (criterion 2); decide whether `ApplyTheme` validates.
- Router assertions `.(Screen)` (13) can panic at runtime; consider a typed `setView`.
- Paste in the 36 `KeyMsg`-gated views (criterion 8).
- `go-runewidth` moved to v0.0.31 through tidy, changing flag widths in the 19 remaining `runewidth` sites.
- `tea.KeyMsg` kept at 103 production sites matches key *release* events too; harmless until keyboard enhancements are requested, so migrate to `KeyPressMsg` in commit b.

Le moteur v2 utilise la largeur par graphème seulement si le terminal répond au mode 2027 ; sans cela les emoji VS16/ZWJ divergent de runewidth de datatable. À vérifier en vrai terminal (DEVDESK-207). go mod tidy monte go-runewidth à v0.0.31 (largeur des drapeaux, 19 appels).
  • ntcharts (e) : 1 ligne d'import, API présente, tests dashboard verts.

Non vérifié par le spike

Aucun vrai terminal (mode 2027/2026, Windows Terminal, WSL, tmux, Nerd Font), les 4 tea.ExecProcess, mise run lint, test-race, TestMeasureRedrawCost, curseur virtuel. Ces points restent à couvrir dans cette story et DEVDESK-207.

J'ai reporté les conclusions du spike dans un commentaire sur DEVDESK-201. Je n'ai modifié ni sa description ni ses critères d'acceptation, et il reste en Backlog.

Le commentaire reprend :
- tes deux décisions : rejet d'un hex invalide dans `ApplyTheme`, et `tea.WithColorProfile(TrueColor)` à la place du contournement de `main.go` ;
- ce qu'il faut faire dans chaque commit : thème, touches, routeur, collage, bubbles, profil couleur et ntcharts ;
- ce que le spike n'a pas vérifié : vrai terminal, `ExecProcess`, lint, `test-race` et `TestMeasureRedrawCost`.

**À corriger dans la story :** le critère 4(3) et le commit (d) prévoient de désactiver ←/→ dans les viewports. Le spike montre qu'il n'y a rien à désactiver : seul le viewport d'aide reçoit des touches brutes, et son `arrowOnlyScroll` n'a déjà pas Gauche/Droite. J'ai signalé ce point dans le commentaire.

Veux-tu que je fasse reformuler ce critère dans la description par le `pm` ?
